title: Let seeking kneel before it wanders
summary: This meets the search that keeps multiplying methods while resisting surrender. The line sends the search to Naam and the Guru's service.
lifeApplication: Before trying another method, do one act of service and repeat the Name until the search stops performing itself.

source.shortMeaning: Release is found where Naam and service meet the Guru.
source.lifeApplication: Before trying another method, do one act of service and repeat the Name until the search stops performing itself.

evidence.coreClaim: Release is found where Naam and service meet the Guru.
evidence.turn: Seeking matures when it bows into the Name and service.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before trying another method, do one act of service and repeat the Name until the search stops performing itself.
